source: Codex read-only GitHub and AWS API delivery observation

collector.name: codex-read-only-delivery-observation
collector.principalClass: repository automation using existing GitHub and temporary AWS console-authenticated CLI sessions

scope: Wave 2 delivered worker and outbox monitoring; bounded operator observation
observation: The deployment completed on the expected worker image. Read-only ECS, CloudWatch and SQL observations show runtime polling, zero pending or blocked items and four alarms in OK. The heartbeat alarm changed from ALARM before deployment to OK after real polling. The OIDC monitoring run denied DescribeAlarms; no IAM policy was changed. Broader role permissions and continuing control effectiveness are outside this observation.
requiredNextEvidence: Role policy and policy simulation receipts for each named action and representative in-scope and out-of-scope resources; live diagnostic reads when available.
redaction: No credentials, account identifiers, role identifiers, task identifiers, customer payloads, or raw worker logs are retained. GitHub run and commit identifiers refer only to the repository delivery history.
limitations: Point-in-time operator observation, not independent assurance.
Alarm actions are not configured; alarm evaluation and state are observed in CloudWatch.
OIDC diagnostic permissions remain separate from the authorized operator session.
